items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: La Rosa... organized a band and he joined the first La Conga... I was the second voice

ctx.x: Yes, he was, con La Conga he went out there. As a matter of fact, when Panchito left to Los Angeles or to Hollywood, ahhh - La Rosa, is another Cuban band leader, he organized a band and he joined the first La Conga. That was in 57th and 5th Avenue; and Alfredito Valdes was the lead singer. I was the second voice and Oh!, we had a tremendous time. Alfredito Valdes, Vicentico Valdes's brother ...
